story.zh: 汉室衰微，十常侍乱政。长沙区星聚众反叛，与周朝、郭石分据三郡。孙坚奉朝廷之命，率军讨逆。
story.en: The Han house declines as the Ten Attendants disrupt governance. In Changsha, Ou Xing rallies rebels, dividing three commanderies with Zhou Chao and Guo Shi. Sun Jian leads an army to suppress the rebellion by imperial decree.

trigger.zh: 孙坚、程普、黄盖、韩当、祖茂、朱治、吴景、区星、周朝、郭石存活且身属正确势力。
trigger.en: Sun Jian, Cheng Pu, Huang Gai, Han Dang, Zu Mao, Zhu Zhi, Wu Jing, Ou Xing, Zhou Chao, and Guo Shi are alive and belong to the correct factions.

forbidden.zh: 主角为区星、周朝、郭石时无法触发，主角不为区星、周朝、郭石势力。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Ou Xing, Zhou Chao, or Guo Shi, protagonist must not belong to Ou Xing, Zhou Chao, or Guo Shi's faction.

participate.zh: 【身属孙坚势力】或【与孙坚关系等级至少为3级】。
participate.en: 【Belong to Sun Jian's faction】 or 【Relationship level with Sun Jian is at least Level 3】.

defy.zh: 【使区星、周朝、郭石存活并使其成为家将】。
defy.en: 【Ensure Ou Xing, Zhou Chao, and Guo Shi survive and recruit them as Retainers】.

force.zh: 孙坚身为君主并占领<下邳>或<零陵>
force.en: Sun Jian is a Ruler and controls <Xiapi> or <Lingling>

force.zh: 程普、黄盖、韩当、祖茂、朱治、吴景回归孙坚势力
force.en: Cheng Pu, Huang Gai, Han Dang, Zu Mao, Zhu Zhi, and Wu Jing return to Sun Jian's Faction.
